items.title: 2.10 Ek dimension mein inelastic takrao (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.10 with Fig. 2.16 and Example 2.10 (PDF 45-46, 50).

blocks.text: Masses m1 aur m2 ke do ajsam lein jo velocities v1i aur v2i se ek hi lakeer mein chalte hain, v1i, v2i se bari, taake m1 projectile aur m2 target mana jaye. Waqt t ke baad ajsam inelastic takrao karte aur chipak jate hain; un ka mila hua mass m1 + m2 takrao ke baad aakhri velocity vf se chalta hai (Fig. 2.16). Chunke takrao perfectly inelastic hai, kul momentum baqi rehta hai: pehle ka kul momentum = baad ka kul momentum, m1 v1i + m2 v2i = (m1 + m2) vf, to vf = (m1/(m1 + m2)) v1i + (m2/(m1 + m2)) v2i, inelastic takrao ke baad jism ki mushtarka velocity. Khaas soorat mein jab target m2 sukoon mein ho, v2i = 0, vf = (m1/(m1 + m2)) v1i ... (2.37): m1 ki velocity mass ratio m1/(m1 + m2) se ghat jati hai; m1 ka mass jitna bara, milap utna tez chalta hai.

blocks.alt: Takrao se pehle: gend m1 velocity v1i se aur bari gend m2 velocity v2i se, dono daen taraf. Takrao ke baad: ek bara jism m1 + m2, andar gehra hissa, velocity vf se daen taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.16: Ek dimension mein perfectly inelastic takrao (kitab ki Figure 2.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Takrao se pehle system ki kinetic energy (KE)i = (1/2) m1 v1i^2 + (1/2) m2 v2i^2 hai, aur takrao ke baad milap ki kinetic energy (KE)f = (1/2)(m1 + m2) vf^2. Zaya hone wali kinetic energy ka hissa ((KE)i - (KE)f)/(KE)i = ([(1/2) m1 v1i^2 + (1/2) m2 v2i^2] - (1/2)(m1 + m2) vf^2) / [(1/2) m1 v1i^2 + (1/2) m2 v2i^2]. (2.37) se vf ki qeemat rakh kar aur sukoon mein target (v2i = 0) ki khaas soorat le kar hal karne se ((KE)i - (KE)f)/(KE)i = m2/(m1 + m2) ... (2.38). Yeh inelastic takrao ke doran zaya hone wali kinetic energy ka hissa hai; ek dimension mein inelastic takrao ke doran energy zaya hoti hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.10 (print mein 2.12 ke baad)
blocks.text: 2 kg mass ki projectile ibtidai velocity 4 m s^-1 se daen taraf chalti hui 3 kg mass ke sukoon mein target se takrati hai; takrao ke baad dono masses chipak kar ek jism ke taur par 1.6 m s^-1 ki velocity se chalte hain. Perfectly inelastic takrao ke doran momentum ke baqa ka qanoon aur energy ka nuqsan dikhayein. Hal: x-simt mein ibtidai momentum p = m1 v1i + m2 v2i = (2 kg x 4 m s^-1) + (3 kg x 0) = 8 kg m s^-1 (v2i = 0). Mila hua mass M = m1 + m2 = 2 kg + 3 kg = 5 kg aur vf = 1.6 m s^-1, to aakhri momentum M vf = 5 kg x 1.6 m s^-1 = 8 kg m s^-1. Ibtidai KE = (1/2) x 2 kg x (4 m s^-1)^2 + (1/2) x 3 kg x 0 = 16 J; aakhri KE = (1/2)(m1 + m2) vf^2 = (1/2) x 5 kg x (1.6 m s^-1)^2 = 6.4 J; energy ka nuqsan = 16 J - 6.4 J = 9.6 J. Momentum baqi hai magar kinetic energy zaya hui.

blocks.prompt: Example 2.10 ko equations (2.37) aur (2.38) se jaanchein.
blocks.explanation: vf = m1 v1i/(m1 + m2) = 2 x 4/5 = 1.6 m s^-1, jaisa diya hai. Zaya hissa m2/(m1 + m2) = 3/5 = 0.6 hona chahiye, aur waqai 9.6 J / 16 J = 0.6.

items: Perfectly inelastic: ajsam chipakte hain; momentum baqi, m1 v1i + m2 v2i = (m1 + m2) vf; target sukoon mein: vf = m1 v1i/(m1 + m2) aur zaya KE ka hissa m2/(m1 + m2). Example 2.10: pehle aur baad 8 kg m s^-1, 16 J mein se 9.6 J zaya.
